license.notes: Roadmap 240, the walker's Philly comps: the wooden distribution pole that carries a street's cobra-head and its wires. REFERENCE: US distribution practice -- a 40 ft wood pole set about 6 ft deep (about 10.4 m standing, 0.30 m across at grade, 0.19 m at the top, ANSI O5.1 class 4), an 8 ft crossarm a foot under the top with steel braces and three pin insulators for the primaries, the neutral and the secondary on spools behind the pole, two communication cables lowest, a cobra-head about 25 ft up on a 6 ft mast arm facing the road, and on the `transformer` form a pole-mount can under the neutral; the comps and the walker decide, these fill blanks. Laid out in `core/utility_pole_forms.py`, which also holds the numbers Lot mirrors. BUILT: 496 tris (`auto`) and 592 (`transformer`) at their module dims, four materials, 0 coincident face pairs (2026-10-12).
